levels.text: Recomputing the sum of every window from scratch costs O(n·k). What stays the same between one window and the next?
When the window slides one step to the right, exactly one element enters and one leaves. Adjust a running sum by those two values.
Initialise the running sum with the first k elements, then for each i from k to n-1 add nums[i], subtract nums[i-k], and track the maximum.
